description: Convert Word (DOCX, DOC), OpenDocument (ODT) and RTF documents into PDFs ready to send or print. Returns a link to download the result (kept about an hour). Credits on paid plans: 10 per file.

files.description: Input files (.doc, .docx, .odt, .rtf). Each one is a public http(s) URL, or an object with `url`, or with `name` and `content_base64` (small files only: up to 20 MB in total).

anyOf.description: public http(s) URL of the file

name.description: file name with its extension, e.g. report.pdf

url.description: public http(s) URL of the file

name: word_to_pdf
title: Convert Word to PDF
